hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"PLAN TRACKING (project rule): if this prompt starts or continues work that runs an ExecForge role (c-level, execforge, eng-level, q-level, sec-level, design-html, full-cycle, CEO/COO review), keep a plan file under plans/. NEW task: create plans/YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS-ss_<title>.md (ss = hundredths of a second; use dashes, never colons — a colon in a committed filename breaks git clone on Windows) using plans/TEMPLATE.md and write the plan BEFORE doing the work. SAME task as an earlier prompt: update that existing file (progress, decisions, status) instead of creating a new one; do not start a second file for the same task. No role involved: no plan file needed. WRITE THE PLAN FILE IN PLAIN, SIMPLE ENGLISH: short everyday words, short sentences, no jargon. If a technical term is unavoidable, say in a few words what it means. A reader who does not know this codebase should still follow it."}}'
